questions.stem_text: Why did Lincoln oppose the southward expansion of the US?

options.A: It would have drained the US economically
options.B: It would have involved compromising opposition to slavery
options.C: It would have increased immigration to the US

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It would have involved compromising opposition to slavery

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of appellate courts?

options.A: Appellate judges never use the stare decisis principle.
options.B: Appellate trials are usually jury trials.
options.C: Appellate judges usually decide the facts of a case.
options.D: Appellate judges review decisions of lower courts.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Appellate judges review decisions of lower courts.

questions.stem_text: What is meant by the term 'cyber-crime'?

options.A: Any crime that uses computers to jeopardise or attempt to jeopardise national security
options.B: The use of computer networks to commit financial or identity fraud
options.D: Any crime that involves computers and networks

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Any crime that involves computers and networks

questions.stem_text:
The swift adoption of the Bill of Rights in the years following ratification of the
Constitution demonstrates the

options.A: Framers' unqualified commitment to individual rights
options.B: small states' determination to receive equal representation in the legislature
options.D: states' fears of an overpowerful national government

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - states' fears of an overpowerful national government

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is true of the House Committee on Ways and Means?

options.A: Its primary role is to appropriate spending for infrastructure projects.
options.B: It is the primary author of congressional banking reform legislation.
options.C: It allocates funding for canals and waterways.
options.D: Its jurisdiction includes the tax system.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Its jurisdiction includes the tax system.
